$comment: x4 design tokens. Source: Figma fgEvP6Ms0bOAbWxfkFki4R, node JSON in ui/figma/nodes/ (REST pull 2026-11-01: 73:368 'states', 83:2147 'settings states', footer and overlay components). Values marked figma:false are not in the design and support screens the design does not cover (diagnostics, toasts). Layout values ending in Y/X for text are LVGL label positions: the Figma baseline (box top + ascent, or + cap height for cap-trimmed text) minus the LVGL font's baseline offset (line_height - base_line). Regenerate core/src/ui/tokens.h with `python tools/gen_tokens.py`.

bg.use: Figma variable Backround/Primary: dark ink, borders and text on light surfaces

ink.use: tile frames, bars and text on the settings screen (tile components 83:2147)

onPhoto.use: text over the photo (menu, footer, Saving/Error)

glow.use: footer glows (Overlay Element 18:587; alpha baked into the assets)

rec.use: recording dot and its glow (Rec Timer 83:867)

sliderText.use: cam delay value over the grey: Figma draws it white with EXCLUSION blend = #2E2E2E on #D1D1D1, white on the black fill

accent.use: primary button (white on dark, like the design's type)

tile.use: settings tiles: orientation, cam delay, flashlight

footerPadX.use: footer text inset from the screen edge

footerTextY.use: footer label top: Figma box y 24 + ascent = baseline 38; Space Mono Bold 13 baseline is 12 below the label top

recDotY.use: record dot top in the footer

recGlowY.use: record glow image top in the footer (54x31, from x 0)

glowY.use: footer glow images top in the footer (72 px tall, ellipse centre on the footer bottom)

flashGap.use: bolt to charge % gap (Flash Readiness Level 83:1188)

sdUnitGap.use: gap between SD number and unit (Figma uses a thin space, not in Space Mono)

menuLabelY.use: tap menu label top (serif 32, box y 6 + ascent = baseline 37.7; LVGL baseline is 28 below the label top)

swipeDecidePx.use: settings: a touch that moves this far becomes a swipe (vertical) or a cam delay drag (horizontal), not a tap

swipeDismissPx.use: settings: let go after a swipe up of this many px (or a flick) and the sheet slides away

tileBarH.use: orientation horzntl: top and bottom bar height

tileBarV.use: orientation vertcl: left and right bar width

tileLabelY.use: orientation label top (serif 36, cap box y 36 -> baseline 62)

flashLabelY.use: flashlight label top (serif 36, cap box y 37 -> baseline 63)

delayLabelY.use: cam delay label top (serif 36, cap box y 66 -> baseline 92)

delayLabelR.use: cam delay label inset from the tile's right edge

styleLabelY.use: style label top (serif 34, cap box y 68 -> baseline 92)

styleStripX.use: style tile gradient / dither strip left edge (40x100)

stateTitleY.use: Saving... / Error label top (serif 48, box y 95 -> baseline 142)

savingTitleX.use: Saving... left edge (the word is centred, the dots trail)

stateSubY.use: 'k of n' label top (serif 24, box y 199 -> baseline 223)

savingOfX.use: k is right-aligned to this x, ' of n' starts here

portraitW.use: portrait: the centre crop that stays as it is (Figma 73:206)

portraitTileW.use: portrait: each side shows a 111 px copy of the frame's middle (left at x -41, right at x 250; 70 px of each visible)

portraitTileOpa.use: portrait: side copies' opacity in percent, over the screen background (bg)
